{
  "conventions": [
    "Begin every newly created .ts or .tsx file with the Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026 (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).",
    "Format code with 2-space indentation, single quotes, trailing commas, and semicolons matching @backstage/cli/config/prettier.",
    "Use named exports with explicit @public or @alpha TSDoc release tags on all exported symbols re-exported from package entrypoints.",
    "Import useTranslationRef from @backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha in plugins/notifications components and consume notificationsTranslationRef.",
    "Never add data-testid attributes or use *ByTestId queries in components or tests; use accessible roles, labels, and text with screen and findBy* queries.",
    "Clean up all timers (clearInterval) and lodash throttled callbacks (.cancel()) in React useEffect cleanup functions on unmount.",
    "Only import packages declared in the respective package.json dependencies, devDependencies, or peerDependencies."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "CardExtension Progress fallback outside AppContext",
      "choice": "Wrap useApp().getComponents().Progress in a try/catch inside CardExtension and fall back to Progress from @backstage/core-components when useApp() throws",

        "Requiring callers to wrap CardExtension in TestApp",
        "Replacing app.getComponents().Progress unconditionally"

      "reason": "Preserves custom app Progress components when inside a Backstage AppContext while allowing CardExtension and createCardExtension cards to render in isolated unit tests without an AppContext."
